task.instruction: Find AirPods on Apple and how many types are currently available.

final_answer:
On apple.com, the AirPods line currently shows four models available to buy, across three families:

**AirPods 5** — new, in-ear, with Active Noise Cancellation. Two versions:
• AirPods 5 with Charging Case (USB‑C) — **$129**
• AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case — **$149**

**AirPods Pro 3** — in-ear, "the world's best in-ear Active Noise Cancellation," adds heart rate sensing during workouts and Hearing Test / Hearing Aid / Hearing Protection features — **$249**

**AirPods Max 2** — over-ear, "Listening. Remastered." with a Digital Crown and up to 20 hours of battery — **$549** (available in Midnight, Starlight, Blue, Purple, Orange)

So: **4 distinct products currently on sale** (or **3 models** if you group the two AirPods 5 case variants together). Note that Apple's Compare AirPods page still lists eleven entries — it also includes older/discontinued models such as AirPods 4, AirPods 4 with ANC, AirPods Pro 2, the original AirPods Max, AirPods (2nd generation), and AirPods (3rd generation) with Lightning or MagSafe cases — but only the four above are part of the current purchasing lineup shown on the AirPods landing page.

judge.rationale: The agent used Apple AirPods pages showing AirPods 5 variants, Pro 3, and Max 2 with Buy links/prices, and answered the current count as 4 products/3 grouped models.
